name: genesis_voice_identify
description: Look up whether the caller's number is one Genesis recognizes. Call this FIRST, before anything else, and branch on the result. `known` tells you whether the number is on file. `canFollowUp` tells you whether an answer can actually be delivered back to them later — it is frequently false, and when it is false you must not offer a follow-up. The callerId argument is bound to the provider's system caller id — you do not supply it.

request_body_schema.description: The caller's number, as presented by the telephony provider.
